Subject: Recap & next steps: Procurement path for Redwood pilot (PR / Supplier ID)

Hi Priya / Sam,

Thanks again for the quick call this morning — great to hear the project timelines and compliance bar. Short recap and concrete next steps so procurement can move forward: 

- Pilot scope: 3 months, dedicated instance, up to 10k monthly inference hours.
- Preferred commercial path: you mentioned procurement would prefer a PO vs card for anything above $25k.
- Marketplace: you asked whether Redwood can be purchased via Coupa/Ariba or cloud marketplace (AWS Marketplace).

Actions we need from FinServ to create an internal Purchase Requisition (PR):
1) Confirm commercial vehicle: PO (standard) or card/payments?
2) If PO, provide FinServ supplier template or tell us whether you need Redwood to be listed as a supplier in Coupa or Ariba.
3) Any internal approver names / cost center / PR reference you want on the requisition.

What we can provide immediately:
- Redwood can accept a standard PO or be onboarded as a supplier in Coupa/Ariba. If you want marketplace purchase, we can confirm availability on AWS/Azure market and share publisher IDs.
- Attached: Redwood_SOW_template.pdf (scope/SLA for the pilot) and Coupa_Supplier_Form.xlsx (fillable supplier info).

If you want, we can also draft a pre-populated PR for your procurement team (we just need the cost center and approver). Which would you prefer?

Next steps: please reply with your preferred procurement path and any internal docs. Once we get that, I will either (a) draft the PR for you, or (b) loop in our vendor ops and supply the supplier ID/registration instructions.

Thanks — happy to hop on a quick call with procurement if helpful.

Best,
Marissa Cole
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
marissa.cole@redwood.com | +1 415-555-0123
Redwood Inference

Hi all — thanks for the details, Priya. Below is a short, copy-paste checklist for onboarding Redwood into Coupa/Ariba and for creating a Purchase Requisition (PR) on your side. I also included our vendor/supplier ID if procurement wants to reference an existing record.

Quick answers: 
- Company name for supplier record: Redwood Inference, Inc.
- TAX / EIN (US): 27-1987654 (W-9 available on request).
- Redwood remit address: 210 Market St, Suite 400, San Francisco, CA 94105
- Bank remit: Redwood Inference, Inc. — ACH details shared after NDA / vendor form (we can provide with signed SOW).
- Existing Supplier ID: RW-987654 (internal vendor ops ID) — note: some customers map our internal ID to their Coupa/Ariba supplier number.

Coupa onboarding checklist (fields we recommend you populate):
1) Supplier legal name: Redwood Inference, Inc.
2) DBA / billing name (if different): Redwood Inference
3) Tax ID / W-9: 27-1987654 (attach W-9 PDF)
4) Remit / invoice address: 210 Market St, Suite 400, San Francisco, CA 94105
5) Primary AP contact email for invoices: invoices@redwood.com
6) Bank details (for ACH): provide after vendor registration — we can email securely or upload to your Coupa form.
7) Default invoice/payment terms: Net 30 (negotiable)
8) Supplier class: Software / SaaS

Ariba notes: Ariba usually needs the same docs but with a publisher punch-out or EDI setup for marketplace purchases. If FinServ prefers Ariba, we can route vendor ops to your Ariba contact to expedite.

PR drafting notes (what we can pre-populate for you):
- Line item: Redwood Pilot (Dedicated instance) — 3 months — estimated $XX,XXX
- Cost center: [to be provided by FinServ]
- Approver: [to be provided by FinServ]
- Contract reference: Redwood_SOW_template.pdf

Internal ticketing / next steps: 
- I opened SUP-3421 to track vendor onboarding and supplier ID mapping: https://redwood.atlassian.net/browse/SUP-3421
- If FinServ wants a pre-populated PR, Marissa — I can draft it and attach the SOW + vendor packet.

Attachments to this email for your procurement team: PR-creation-cheatsheet.pdf (one-page checklist), Coupa_Fillable_Instructions.docx

Timeframe: vendor onboarding typically completes in 3-7 business days once the supplier form + W-9 are submitted. If procurement needs an expedited path we can accept a one-off PO in parallel.

Let me know if you want a short joint call with procurement to walk through the Coupa form fields. Happy to join.
